description: This Java class defines a SearchFacet model with attributes such as name, key, and count, including their getters and setters, representing a facet used in search functionalities.

classes.name: SearchFacet
classes.description: A Java POJO representing a search facet, containing fields for name, key, and count, with corresponding accessor methods.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the key for this search facet.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of this search facet.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of this search facet.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this search facet.

methods.name: setCount
methods.description: Sets the count associated with this search facet.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count of this search facet.
